prompt: I need to establish a research repository for LLM applications in quantitative finance. Priority areas: LLM for financial analysis and prediction (highest), risk management and portfolio optimization with LLMs, and market sentiment analysis using large language models. Include financial-domain specific tags and terminology.

assertions.name: core_files_created
assertions.text: Core configuration files exist: README.md, CLAUDE.md, research-focus.md, classification-guide.md, .gitignore, LICENSE

assertions.name: git_initialized
assertions.text: Git repository initialized with initial commit

assertions.name: skills_created_with_content
assertions.text: Domain-specific skills created: .claude/skills/search-papers/SKILL.md and .claude/skills/add-paper/SKILL.md exist with content

assertions.name: skills_references
assertions.text: Skills have reference files: search-papers/references/queries.md and add-paper/references/notes-template.md exist

assertions.name: bilingual_support
assertions.text: Bilingual README files: both README.md and README_zh.md exist

assertions.name: research_focus_priorities
assertions.text: research-focus.md contains 3 priority levels with search queries

assertions.name: domain_specific_content
assertions.text: Repository contains financial-domain specific terminology and tags as requested
